languages: Elvish, Deep speech, Common, Slyvan, Orcish
bonds: Deep bonds to nature and the woodlands
backstory:
Born to one of the highest-ranking elf species which rank people based on beauty he grew up well fed, when he was a child, his horn was broken resulting in his parents faking his death and hiding him within they're chambers below. 

At 16 Auron escaped and ran away, he lived in the woodlands surviving with only what the woods provided as he made his way to the outer lands. He began to steal to keep himself alive finding abandoned buildings to live amongst. 

He was found by a group of men which promised him food and shelter in exchange for him slaying monsters and collecting hidden treasures for them. 

He slayed a Basilisk to obtain a large crystal which was stolen by an unwanted guest, which lead to led to a series of unfortunate events.....
appearance:
Auron has light grey skin with piercing green eyes, he has long brown hair tied loosey in a bun with some hair hanging down by his ears. He has a scruffy beard and moustache and has medium sized horns with 1 being broken being ~ 1/2 horn, he has legs that end in hooves with short, pointed ears. 

He wears dark/natural-coloured clothes, a long-sleeved hooded shirt with pants that cover his legs with only his hooves exposed. He carried a longbow and arrow bag on his back with a small satchel on his side.
hair: Long, brown hair tied in a loose bun

feats.name: Lucky [Origin]
feats.desc: I gain a number of Luck Points equal to my Prof Bonus and can use them to give myself Advantage on a D20 Test, or to give a creature who rolls a d20 for an attack roll against me Disadvantage on that roll.

magicItems.name: Cloak of the Manta Ray
magicItems.desc: While wearing this cloak, I can breathe underwater, and I have a Swim Speed of 60 feet.

magicItems.name: Dusk Dagger
magicItems.desc: This delicately curved dagger is ornamented with crescent moon designs. When I hit a creature that is completely in dim light or darkness with this magic weapon, that creature takes an extra 1d8 psychic damage.

magicItems.name: Feywood Ivy
magicItems.desc: This glowing-rune seed can be commanded (action) to sprout vines covering a held weapon or object, giving it a comfortable grip, automatic sheathing, and making it function as my spellcasting focus. I cannot be disarmed of the vine-covered object unless Incapacitated. A second command word (bonus action) lashes the vines at a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet — on a failed DC 13 Dexterity save, it is Grappled and Restrained for 1 minute; it can use an action to attempt DC 13 Str or Dex to escape. The effect ends if I move more than 5 feet away. Once the vine lash is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

magicItems.name: Amulet of Primal Wisdom
magicItems.desc: My Wisdom score is 19 while I wear this amulet, crafted from dried magical leaves encased in sap. It has no effect if my Wisdom is already 19 or higher.

magicItems.name: Urnblade
magicItems.desc:
This item appears to be a small cremation urn. While grasping the urn, you can use a bonus action to speak its first command word and cause its lid to unseal. When you do, a curved blade of dark smoke pours from the mouth of the urn. Speaking the command word again reseals the urn and causes the blade to disappear. If you are proficient with shortswords or longswords, you are proficient with the urnblade.

You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon, which deals necrotic damage instead of slashing damage.

*Shadow Ally.* While holding the urn, you can use an action to speak its second command word to animate your body's shadow, transforming it into an undead creature. When you do, your body's shadow detaches from you and becomes a shadow in an unoccupied space that you can see within 10 feet of you.

On your turn, you can mentally command the shadow if you aren't incapacitated. You decide what action the shadow takes and where it moves during its next turn, or you can issue it a general command, such as to attack your enemies or guard a location. The GM has the shadow's statistics. This shadow doesn't cause a new one to appear when a non-evil humanoid dies from its attacks.

The urnblade's bonus to attack and damage rolls becomes +2 while the summoned shadow exists. In addition, if you are the target of an attack and are within 5 feet of the shadow, you can use your reaction to command your shadow to become the target of the attack instead.

The shadow disappears when it drops to 0 hit points, when it's farther than 120 feet from you, or when you use an action to dismiss it. When it disappears, your cast shadow returns. If the shadow drops to 0 hit points, there is a cumulative 5 percent chance that the urn turns to dust and is destroyed.
